statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-59890 (GHSA-h35f-9h28-mq5c): setuptools' FileList applied MANIFEST.in exclude, global-exclude, recursive-exclude and prune rules without Unicode normalization, so on macOS APFS or HFS+ a file name stored in NFD could bypass an NFC exclusion rule and be packed into a source distribution. It affects setuptools 82.0.1 and earlier and is fixed upstream in 83.0.0 by https://github.com/pypa/setuptools/commit/dd9f436a36486b4cb8a4c70a2321548b0be09b8f, which adds unicode_utils.normalize() and wraps the pattern compiled by translate_pattern in a _NormalizedMatcher (https://github.com/pypa/setuptools/security/advisories/GHSA-h35f-9h28-mq5c, https://github.com/pypa/setuptools/releases/tag/v83.0.0). Checked setuptools/command/egg_info.py and setuptools/unicode_utils.py, and the compiled egg_info bytecode in the -pyc subpackage, in every py3.14-setuptools package published for Alpine 3.24 (82.0.1-r1, 82.0.1-r2, 84.0.0-r0 and 84.0.0-r1; the x86_64 and aarch64 packages are byte-identical). 82.0.1-r1 ships setuptools 82.0.1 without the fix. 82.0.1-r2 ships setuptools 82.0.1 with the upstream fix backported: its egg_info.py and unicode_utils.py differ from 82.0.1-r1 only by that commit's changes. 84.0.0-r0 and 84.0.0-r1 ship setuptools 84.0.0, which contains the fix. The range ends at 82.0.1-r2.

CVE-2026-59890 (GHSA-h35f-9h28-mq5c): setuptools' sdist command could pack files that MANIFEST.in excludes when their names collide under Unicode NFC/NFD normalization on macOS APFS or HFS+ file systems, because FileList in setuptools/command/egg_info.py matched patterns against raw file names. It affects setuptools before 83.0.0 and is fixed in 83.0.0 by commit dd9f436: https://github.com/pypa/setuptools/security/advisories/GHSA-h35f-9h28-mq5c, https://github.com/pypa/setuptools/commit/dd9f436a36486b4cb8a4c70a2321548b0be09b8f. We read every published package built from the airflow source in the DHI Debian repository: 52 airflow builds, 3.3.0-0 to the current 3.4.0-11, for amd64 and arm64, each matching its index checksum (no debug-symbol packages are published for this source). We listed every file and symlink in each package and inside the wheel, zip, jar and tar.gz archives it carries, and read the version from every setuptools dist-info METADATA file; both architectures agree in every build. Builds 3.3.0-0 to 3.4.0-0 contain no setuptools, pkg_resources or _distutils_hack files at all. Builds 3.4.0-1 to 3.4.0-11 contain setuptools 84.2.1 in two places: installed under /usr/lib/airflow/lib/python3.13/site-packages, and as the setuptools-84.2.1 wheel that virtualenv embeds for new environments; in 3.4.0-1 and 3.4.0-11 both copies of setuptools/command/egg_info.py carry the fix's Unicode normalization of MANIFEST.in matching. These builds also embed the virtualenv pip 26.2.2 wheel, whose pip/_vendor/vendor.txt lists setuptools==70.3.0: pip vendors only pkg_resources/__init__.py (and its LICENSE) from that release, which has no FileList class, no MANIFEST.in handling and no sdist command, so it does not contain the vulnerable code. No build contains a setuptools distribution older than 83.0.0, so every published build is on the fixed side and the range ends at the first published build, 3.3.0-0.
